The '''Ovise system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. The Ovise system contained five [[Planet/Legends|planets]].
